# Both reports retain known work facts when required readiness information is missing.
mkdir caller
cd caller
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle ../bundle --allow-source ../docs,extra --allow-source ../other
! stderr .
stdout 'Project: Independent project \[independent-project\]'
stdout 'Current commitments:'
stdout 'Finished setup \[setup\]'
stdout 'execution: completed'
stdout 'triage: ready-for-agent'
stdout 'committed: true'
stdout 'readiness: unknown'
stdout 'eligible: false'
stdout 'Shortlist: none'
stdout 'Sources:'
stdout 'goal.md'
stdout 'spec.md'
stdout 'Task context:'
! stdout 'Private linked goal body'
! stdout 'Private linked requirement body'
cmp ../bundle/task.md ../original-task.md

exit 1 ctx orient --bundle ../bundle --allow-source ../docs,extra --allow-source ../other --json
! stderr .
cp stdout report.json
jsonorientation report.json false
stdout '"execution":"completed"'
stdout '"committed":true'
stdout '"eligible":false'
stdout '"fingerprintVersion":'
! stdout 'Private linked goal body'
! stdout 'Private linked requirement body'
cmp ../bundle/task.md ../original-task.md

# External documents require the supplied roots.
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle ../bundle --json
! stderr .
stdout 'source_outside_scope'
